android.desc:
Ever wondered what your chats really mean?
Toedok: Read the Vibe analyzes your conversations to uncover hidden emotions, tone, and personality hints — and provides smart reply suggestions based on the context!

🔥 Key Features

📊 Conversation Flow: Track changes in your chats over time.

😊 Emotional Insights: Discover the mood and emotions behind every message.

🧩 MBTI Analysis: AI estimates your conversation partner’s personality and communication style.

💡 Smart Reply Suggestions: Get clever, context-aware responses.

⚡ Hope & Crisis Detection: Identify positive or negative signals in your conversations.

Why Toedok?

Works with all major messaging apps.

Super simple: just upload a screenshot and get instant insights.

Privacy first: your chats stay secure and private.

Step into smarter messaging! With Toedok, every conversation becomes smoother, more engaging, and perfectly matched with the right replies.

quotes.text:
Hey everyone

I'm a solo developer from Korea and just released an Android app called *Toedok*.

It uses AI to analyze *chat screenshots (WhatsApp, Messenger, etc.)* and suggests the most natural reply, considering the tone and context.

Example use case:

- You get a confusing message and don’t know how to reply?

- Just take a screenshot → upload it → AI gives a smart suggestion.

I built this because I often found myself overthinking replies in chats

Here’s the app on Google Play (free):

https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.toedok

Would love your feedback – especially from Indian users

Curious if this kind of tool would be useful in daily messaging situations.

Thanks!
